name: Flooded Suburb
description: Rows of houses stand knee-deep in still, brown water. Mailboxes break the surface like grave markers. Something moves behind a curtain that hasn't been drawn in years.

survivors.name: Mara
survivors.need: Tends a rooftop garden above the waterline, and needs the rain barrels hauled up before the dry weeks. Mostly she wants to know whether the stars still look the same from up there.

name: Silent Server Farm
description: A warehouse of dead machines, aisle after aisle, their lights long out. The air is dry and cold. Your footsteps are the loudest thing that has happened here in a decade.

survivors.name: Theo and the kids
survivors.need: Living off the farm's last working generator. It needs a patch Theo can't reach, and three children need to go on believing the power will hold.

name: Overgrown Transit Hub
description: A train station swallowed by green. Vines climb the departure boards; a tree has grown straight up through platform four. Birdsong, of all things. Actual birdsong.

survivors.name: The Dock Radio Operator
survivors.need: An old woman broadcasting a list of names on loop, and where to find her. Her antenna is down. She needs it raised, and she needs something to answer.
